message.text: All four are confirmed now. I should note that the SQL schema is defined per-driver in separate sqlite/mysql/postgres LATEST.sql files, and that proto/store/memo.proto defines the MemoPayload used by the store model.

q23.

- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (the `CREATE TABLE memo` at lines 32–44; equivalent per-driver copies live at `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql` and `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql`)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go` (`type Memo struct`, line 35)
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`message Memo`, line 198)
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (`export type Memo`, line 79)

Two supporting details worth knowing: the `payload` column is itself a protobuf-defined blob, whose shape comes from `proto/store/memo.proto` (`MemoPayload`, generated into `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go`) and is referenced by the store model's `Payload *storepb.MemoPayload` field. The Go server-side generated form of the API message lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.go`, generated from the same `.proto` as the frontend types.
